content: I would recommend using Chocolatey as a package manager for handling dependencies on Windows. Chocolatey is a popular and user-friendly package manager that allows you to easily install, update, and manage software packages on your Windows system. It has a large repository of packages to choose from and makes it easy to keep your applications up to date. Additionally, Chocolatey has a simple command-line interface which makes it easy to automate the installation and management of your software dependencies.
